info.name: Threads Authorization Read And Manage Threads > Retrieve Threads Profiles API
Read And Manage Threads > Retrieve Threads Profiles

params.name: fields
params.description:
id: Threads user ID. This is returned by default.

username: Handle or unique username on Threads. This is the same as the username on Instagram.

threads_profile_picture_url: URL of the user's profile picture on Threads.

threads_biography: Biography text on Threads profile.

items.docs: Use the `GET` /{threads-user-id}?fields=id,username,... [endpoint](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/threads/threads-profiles#retrieve-a-threads-user-s-profile-information) to return profile information about a Threads user.
